answer: In PoA, each directed interaction contributes to an EigenTrust-style matrix, while reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, requiring sustained honest service to preserve influence. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted reciprocity, transitive support, and durable attestations, it cannot cross consensus thresholds, whether disguised as a grove, knoll, or falcon.
